AI SAVES LIVES (5 minutes)
This is the emotionally heaviest slide. Deliver it with gravity and genuine care.
CONTEXT SETTING: SAY: "India has 1 doctor for every 1000 people. But most of those doctors are in cities. In rural areas — places like the villages around Fatehpur — there can be hundreds of kilometres between a patient and a specialist." SAY: "This is not a future problem. This is a NOW problem. And AI is already working on it."
WADHWANI AI: SAY: "A company called Wadhwani AI built a model that detects tuberculosis — TB — from just a cough recording on a basic smartphone. No X-ray machine. No lab. Just a phone and an algorithm trained on thousands of cough sounds." SAY: "One health worker can screen an entire village in a morning. Not because doctors have become less important — but because AI became their remote partner."
AIIMS: SAY: "At AIIMS Delhi, AI reads retina scans and catches diabetic blindness 3 years before a human doctor can see it. 3 years! That's the difference between treatment and permanent blindness."
DISCUSSION QUESTION — spend 2 minutes here: SAY: "Now I want to hear from you. What health problem in YOUR area — in Fatehpur, in your village, in your family — would you want AI to solve?" Take 3-4 answers. These answers are gold. Write them on a piece of paper. Tell them: "These are YOUR AI startup ideas."
